scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @ticketreport/api && npm run build -w @ticketreport/web
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run seed
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @ticketreport/api && npm run typecheck -w @ticketreport/web
